programme.desc: S04 E01 — Stone Cold Justice Return to Jailer's Inn, where the team's first investigation finds a moving ball of environmental changes that registered on multiple meters; see if they can replicate their results as they investigate reports of voices and footsteps from upstairs.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Miami Sinking The coastal metropolis of Miami faces a triple threat of crumbling limestone bedrock, ferocious superstorms and relentless rising oceans.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Sinister Spirits Treading carefully in places where ghosts revisit the scenes of their crimes; confronting vengeful jailhouse spirits in a Missouri home; a malevolent ex-member of the Manson Family in California; a cruel biker in a Salt Lake City residence.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Goldrush Trail Part 2 Haunted Gold Rush follows paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they travel British Columbia's famed gold rush trail and explore its history and its hauntings.
programme.title: History's Most Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Coins, Curses, And Kings Getting insight into the last moments of England's King Richard III; deciphering a manuscript hiding taboo 15th-century knowledge; spotting indications of human sacrifice in Scotland; inspecting silver coins tied to turbulent times in Eastern Europe.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Olde Angel Inn Confronting the visitors that linger in one of Canada's oldest lodgings; travelling to Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, where one of the bloodiest battles of the War of 1812 raged, and trying to.
programme.title: Paranormal Evidence: You Can't Deny it

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Tormented Teens A 16-year-old girl becomes scratched and shaken after a malevolent spirit physically attacks her; a teen uses a spirit board to try to contact the entity behind the paranormal activity in his family's home.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Ghostly Game Over Two friends summon a ghost using six spirit boards; a school in Ireland becomes a paranormal playground after-hours; a young man can't contain himself when he is treated for a voodoo curse.
programme.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S03 E11 — Stonehenge UFOs and More Mysterious lights hover in the skies above Stonehenge on the eve of the summer solstice; a woman witnesses a soul leaving a dead deer's body; a Florida man finds grisly proof of a violent extraterrestrial attack.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Tragic Love (The Ashley Taylor Story) Childhood friends Ashley Taylor and Kevin Sweat reconnect as adults; Ashley's strange pre-wedding disappearance sheds light on Kevin's disturbing past and his connection to a string of unsolved murders.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Billy Meir, The Plejaren and the Multiverse Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Paul Bennewitz and Project Seven Lambs In 1978, UFO enthusiast Paul Bennewitz claims he's intercepted extraterrestrial messages; military officials send counterintelligence officer Richard Doty to feed Bennewitz lies, questioning whether Doty himself is a pawn in an even bigger scheme.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Acts of God Examining various events that are said to have been directed by the hand of the Almighty, such as the Great Flood, the Plagues of Egypt, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses parting the Red Sea.
programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Ghostly Game Over Two friends summon a ghost using six spirit boards; a school in Ireland becomes a paranormal playground after-hours; a young man can't contain himself when he is treated for a voodoo curse.
programme.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera

programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S10 E05 — Music to My Ears A celebrated concert pianist is murdered one night in his studio; Catherine's friendship with the victim's family puts her in unexpected danger.
programme.title: Death in Paradise

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Too Cold for Hell Tracking a local conman, Frank and Lu make some unlikely allies when they encounter a pair of deadly gangsters.
programme.title: Shakespeare and Hathaway: Private Investigators

programme.desc: S22 E01 — Two Spirits: Part 1 Fresh from her trip to the U.S., Nikki and the Lyell unit are called to investigate an attack against a trans man; when two further attacks are reported, it looks like the team is facing an outbreak of violence.
programme.title: Silent Witness

programme.desc: Supersized: Amy In the Sky With Diamonds With bonus scenes; the older siblings are left reeling after being uninvited from Nashville by Tammy; Amy gets closer to her music dreams; Tammy's hope of sister bonding may be falling apart.
programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters

programme.desc: S09 E09 — Panicking at the Disco Amy steps into the spotlight in more ways than one as she prepares for her first time on stage; Andrea shares a surprising health update with Tammy; the older siblings draw a line in the sand.
programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Guac This Way Jaz and Nesha's girls' trip to Mexico gets off to a rocky start; after a stressful flight, accessibility challenges, and beach mishaps, tensions rise between the roomies; a poolside argument tests their friendship.
programme.title: 1000-lb Roomies

programme.desc: S02 E04 — The Girl Who Fell Off Her Stool Emma comes on strong with Jamal, leaving him uneasy; Steven makes his move on Iris despite Razvan's efforts; Michael asks someone out for the first time in two years; sparks fly at sea, but a surprising rumor sends shockwaves through the group.
programme.title: 90 Day: Hunt for Love

programme.desc: S03 E05 — The Assassination of Betsy Mae Vanessa takes a massive step forward on her weight loss journey; Scott addresses the mental side of his food addiction after the girls confront him about not losing enough weight; Tina struggles to adjust to her new life without food.
programme.title: 1000-Lb. Best Friends

programme.desc: S03 E06 — String Cheese, as Far as the Eye Can See Vanessa shows off her body for the first time since her skin removal surgery; Tina continues to mourn the loss of her favorite foods and questions whether the surgery was even worth it; Ashley's dreams of becoming a mother hit another roadblock.
programme.title: 1000-Lb. Best Friends

programme.desc: S05 E32 Rachel Bilson ("Christmas at the Kringles"); viral 8-year-old Tatum Galberth; ATEEZ performs.
programme.title: The Jennifer Hudson Show

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Vibrator in the Rectum Brittany lands in the ER after losing a sex toy in her rectum; Buddy sees Dr. Carothers when he gets a bug in his ear; a pre-teen is brought in to see Dr. Mellick after getting impaled by a massive splinter; Zion has an earring stuck in his ear.
programme.title: Stuck

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Stiletto in the Eye Doctor Crawford needs to remove a barbed nail embedded deeply in the forearm of a patient; Doctor Mellick must meticulously extract an unexpected item from an eye.
programme.title: Stuck

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Scared Cyst-less Taylor is a beautiful young woman who has unsightly elf-like bumps on her ears; Jose never goes out because of the baseball-sized lump on his head; Ken is covered in painful bumps that make it difficult to do everyday things.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S02 E02 — A Lipoma Is Born Barbara's back lump became more noticeable after she lost 131 pounds; Bob has two painful bumps on his back; Hilda's depression is a result of the multitude of bumps on her eyelids; Art has one big bump on his head that he covers up with hats.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Romancing the Lump Dr. Sandra Lee treats Heather, who has a huge growth on her leg and fears removing it could leave a keloid scar; Paul has a giant hump on his back.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Once, Twice, Three Times a Keloid Robert has a small keloid on his ear and a large, snakelike keloid on the back of his head that has been removed and returned three times; Angela has four growths on her head and hides away from those she loves out of embarrassment.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S09 E07 — Krystal's Journey Krystal begins overeating to shield herself with a protective layer of obesity after suffering years of abuse; once a means of protection, her pathological eating now threatens to destroy her life if she doesn't get help.
programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life

programme.desc: S12 E05 — Rose's Journey At age 58, Rose had almost given up and eaten herself to death, but it turned out her family needed her too much for her to go; now she has more than 400 pounds to lose if she wants to get healthy for them, and she's determined to do it.
programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life

programme.desc: S04 E01 — Addicted to Coffee Enemas/Licks Cats Trina and her husband Mike have done nearly 7,000 coffee enemas over the last two and a half years; Lisa has been addicted to licking her cat and eating clumps of hair for three years.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Addicted to Inflatables/ Butt Injection Addict For the last six years, 20-year-old Mark has been addicted to his 15 inflatable pool toys as he eats with them, sleeps with them and even bathes them; Karmello has been getting black market butt injections for the last three years.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Blood Drinker Michelle has been addicted to drinking human and pig blood for 15 years; her mother struggles to accept her addiction and her doctor pushes her to give it up.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Proud to Be Plastic A 44-year-old mother of six has had at least 30 plastic surgery procedures to build the most extreme body in the world; she plans to go under the knife again to double her breast size to a shocking QQQ.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S07 E01 — Raw Meat,Snorting Food, Being Huge Wendy eats up to two pounds of raw meat a day, causing concern with her fiancé's family; Kathryn confesses her food snorting addiction; Craig's bodybuilding obsession is harming his body.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S14 E02 — Missing Pieces A farmer's apparent stroke takes a toxic turn when his pregnant daughter falls ill; a homecoming prank leaves a frat brother unconscious in whipped cream; a firefighter who can't form new memories can't let go of an old one.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: Blind Spot Real doctors in actual emergency rooms, trauma units and intensive care wards recount the heart-pounding cases that changed their lives. Hundreds of cases are examined to find the most amazing, bizarre, humorous and emotional tales of life and death.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S07 E07 — I'm a Squeezer Dr Emma gets to the bottom of why Claire is incessantly picking her skin; after 20 years, Robert finally gets a diagnosis for his painful lumps.
programme.title: Save My Skin
